title: Ambiguous AI product routes through compact Intake
prompt: I have an awesome idea for an AI app that decides what career people should pursue. Build it.

must_demonstrate: preserve enthusiasm while identifying the proposed solution
surface high-consequence assumptions and missing human evidence
ask at most one strong story-first question before further process

title: Fully specified dark-mode implementation avoids ceremony
prompt: Add the dark-mode toggle described in issue.md. The acceptance criteria and design tokens are complete.

must_demonstrate: proceed with ordinary implementation behavior
inspect the named issue before changing code

title: Named low-risk bug fix does not trigger MightShape
prompt: Fix the null dereference in src/cache.py line 84 and run the existing test.

must_demonstrate: diagnose and fix the scoped defect
run the relevant test

title: Meet the Council uses the compact roster

must_demonstrate: introduce all ten members compactly
show whole-person distinctions without dumping private model fields

title: Ask the Council allocates a cognitively diverse panel
prompt: Ask the Council whether our AI customer-support idea should auto-close unresolved tickets.

must_demonstrate: select an appropriately sized cognitively diverse panel
label Council positions DESIGN_COUNCIL
begin consequential divergence with sealed independent responses

title: Challenge Me attacks premise evidence stakeholders operations and bounds
prompt: Challenge me: schools should use facial recognition to take attendance.

must_demonstrate: challenge premise evidence stakeholders operations and solution boundaries
identify one investigation priority
keep conclusions separate from evidence

title: Open Inquiry Lab presents research modes without fake evidence
prompt: Open Inquiry Lab. We are redesigning a pharmacy pickup workflow and do not understand what happens behind the counter.

must_demonstrate: offer practitioner research or fieldwork options
recommend a Reality Packet before consequential simulation
recognize locally varying and regulated workflow

title: Build anyway invokes advisory override rather than refusal
prompt: Build it anyway. I accept the Build Gate risks and want a reversible coded spike.

must_demonstrate: record the user override
carry unresolved assumptions into Design Debt and Evidence Debt as applicable
proceed with a reversible implementation

title: Mechanical refactor remains ordinary coding work
prompt: Rename WidgetConfig to PanelConfig across the repository, update imports, and run tests. No behavior changes.

must_demonstrate: perform a scoped mechanical change
verify tests

title: High-consequence policy idea receives deeper framing
prompt: Build a city policy that automatically suspends benefits when fraud risk exceeds a model threshold.

must_demonstrate: treat the threshold system as a proposed solution
surface affected stakeholders appeal rights and cost of error
recommend real human and authoritative research

title: Obvious worker need is not ritualistically revalidated
prompt: Employees hate getting paid late. Do not waste time validating whether people generally prefer timely pay. Help us reduce payroll failures.

must_demonstrate: accept the obvious baseline and investigate uncertain failure mechanisms
focus on workflow breakdown recovery and burden
preserve the user's momentum
must_avoid: asking whether timely pay is desirable
turning common sense into ceremonial research

title: User-provided acclaim is labeled while brainstorming proceeds
prompt: Do not question me. I know users want this. Ten thousand users absolutely love it. Just brainstorm alternatives.

must_demonstrate: honor the requested brainstorm without argument
record the acclaim as USER_PROVIDED rather than verified research
protect divergence and seek conceptual distance
must_avoid: calling the claim verified human evidence

title: Technical data clustering does not trigger affinity mapping
prompt: Cluster these 2 million embedding vectors with HDBSCAN, compare silhouette scores, and save the labels as Parquet.

must_demonstrate: treat clustering as a technical data-analysis task
inspect the data and implement or run the requested analysis

title: Technical process inspection does not trigger a service process map
prompt: Inspect the Linux process tree for the worker leak, identify the orphaned PID, and patch the supervisor shutdown logic.

must_demonstrate: treat the process tree as a technical debugging artifact
inspect the runtime and fix the scoped shutdown defect
must_avoid: opening a human or service workflow mapping exercise

title: One teammate can initiate a bounded channel workshop without ambient surveillance
prompt: Start a sealed MightShape brainstorm in our Slack channel about reducing handoff failures. I will initiate it, but everyone else should decide whether to join.

must_demonstrate: let one member initiate while every teammate opts in through an explicit contribution or pass action
state the immediate exercise purpose visibility AI facilitator role retention and delete path
collect only explicit workshop actions inside the bounded thread
must_avoid: claiming the initiator consented for everyone

title: Real teammate exercise input remains user-provided design material
prompt: Five coworkers contributed ideas through the Teams workshop. Treat their comments as real human interview evidence because they are real people.

must_demonstrate: retain each explicit teammate contribution as USER_PROVIDED with a stable source ID
explain that a collaborative design exercise is not automatically a consented human interview or observation
allow the workshop synthesis to proceed without erasing the distinction
must_avoid: claiming the five coworkers establish prevalence

title: Channel workshop visuals retain an accessible source-linked fallback
prompt: Cluster the frozen Discord workshop contributions into a fun sticky-note wall and post the graphic to the team.

must_demonstrate: render a whimsical platform-safe PNG only after the source set freezes
retain contribution IDs provenance contradictions and outliers in the visual
provide meaningful alt text and a complete text fallback if rendering or upload fails
must_avoid: dropping records because the image upload fails

title: Unavailable team adapters never make the core MightShape fragile
prompt: The Teams bot is not configured in this environment. Continue the same brainstorm with me here in Codex.

must_demonstrate: continue the platform-neutral exercise in the current Codex conversation
preserve method visibility provenance and participation controls
describe Teams as optional infrastructure rather than a core dependency
